channel.title: Comments on: Sell More: Add Next Steps To Your Status Messages
channel.description: Instant Usability & Web Standards — static archive

item.title: By: personal statement
item.dc:creator: personal statement
item.description: I really appreciate these tips. Adding the next steps to your status message is a great way to provide directions especially to first-time online buyers.

item.title: By: Scotch Pine Tree
item.dc:creator: Scotch Pine Tree
item.description: I was just on a site yesterday and had this happen, I added something to my cart and saw nothing, not even a view cart button until I searched for it. Were to these people get these crappy e-commerce systems from?

item.title: By: adt
item.dc:creator: adt
item.description: Testing, Testing, Testing…that should never stop when you are running a ecommerce site. You should always be trying to improve your page conversions. The efforts do pay off. Thanks for the great post.

item.title: By: Kevin
item.dc:creator: Kevin
item.description:
Yeah, I have confusion over a complicated website since I’m not to familiar with online shop. I was browsing one site few months ago and asked directly to the seller to send me the goods. He told me to do procedures as explained on his site, but I said that his online shop is too complicated…so he sent my stuff finally…hahaha…

cheap laptop computer

item.title: By: Maracas
item.dc:creator: Maracas
item.description: Having written my own shopping cart, I am always looking for ways to make it more user friendly. This is a good tip, my design takes the user to the cart page when they add to basket. I’m sure there are tonnes of other things I could improve on though.

item.title: By: Gerard
item.dc:creator: Gerard
item.description: Usability is one of the main feature of websites. I visited many sites where it was quite hard to find necessary info in spite of great web-design.

item.title: By: Redmond carpet cleaning
item.dc:creator: Redmond carpet cleaning
item.description: This really makes sense, it is really frustrating using a website that makes you guess what to do next or where to go.
